title: dream I had about people in bubbles
content: i had this dream about 4 years ago. I was with a "guide" who was like a short tough guy in rough clothes, almost like Joe Pesci in Home Alone. We were walking through a lavish hotel or office type tower building. With doors and pot plants on the right and glass on the left. Outside the glass there were people in bubbles floating over the city. If I concentrated I could bring a bubble closer to me, and the person inside would start to break up into little blocks, like they were made of Lego. Then the "guide" man grabbed me and said "no! Don't get into that! Start doing that and you can get trapped here forever!" Then he relaxed, chuckled and said "even *me*... even *I* can get tempted into spending too long up here". Then he said "c'mon" and led me up to the roof to look at the view. That's all I can remember.
